name: Google Translate
tagline: Free translation for text, speech, images, documents and websites in a very wide range of languages.
about: Google Translate is the most widely used translation tool. It works in the browser and in mobile apps, including with the phone's camera and microphone.
pros: Translates text, speech, photos, documents and websites.
Covers more languages than most alternatives.
cons: Less natural than specialist tools for some language pairs.
Long or nuanced texts still need a human check.
